channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: FM Nirmala Sitharaman discusses AI-led reforms, procedural simplification at Finance Ministry Chintan Shivir
item.description: All Secretaries of the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Chairmen of Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) and Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC), and the Chief Economic Adviser to the Government of India were also present, besides senior officers from the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, and associated departments.

item.title: 'Try to be kind': Esha Deol shares photoshoot reel, appeals trolls for empathy as she mourns father Dharmendra's death
item.description: Actress Esha Deol, who is still grieving the loss of her beloved father, Dharmendra, has expressed her wish to take a break from social media. Dharmendra passed away on November 24, 2025.

item.title: Kashmir Court Cracks Down on Terror Mastermind: Non-bailable Warrant Issued Against Syed Salah-ud-Din
item.description: In a major legal setback for Pakistan-based Hizbul Mujahideen chief Syed Salah-ud-din, a special NIA court in Kashmir has issued a non-bailable warrant against him in a terror case registered in 2012.

item.title: Mohanlal cries at Sreenivasan's demise, Mammootty consoles him; Kamal Haasan, Rajinikanth pen emotional notes
item.description: Veteran Malayalam actor, screenwriter, and filmmaker Sreenivasan, 69, passed away on Saturday after a prolonged illness. The actor breathed his last at a hospital in Kochi, where he had been undergoing treatment. His cremation will be held on Sunday.

item.title: Jammu and Kashmir completes website audit, shuts 35 portals in cybersecurity push
item.description: Secretary, IT Department, Piyush Singla said that 'Endpoint Detection and Response' and 'Unified Endpoint Management' solutions have been deployed across the Civil Secretariat complexes in Jammu and Srinagar, securing nearly 5,100 devices. He added that another 15,000 devices in head of department offices are slated to be brought under the security framework by January 2026.

item.title: Adani-built Guwahati airport terminal inaugurated by PM Modi, operations to begin by February end
item.description: Gautam Adani, Chairman, Adani Group, said that the Guwahati terminal demonstrates how world-class airport infrastructure can be delivered swiftly while remaining deeply rooted in local identity. "It will strengthen connectivity, support economic growth across the Northeast, and offer passengers a seamless, modern travel experience," said the billionaire industrialist.

item.title: 40-Day Harshest Winter Period "Chillai-Kalan" Begins Tonight, Light Snow Likely in North Kashmir
item.description: The 40-day harshest winter period, Chillai-Kalan, is set to begin from Saturday night in Kashmir, with the Meteorological Department forecasting light to moderate snowfall in the higher reaches of north Kashmir.

item.title: Air pollutants may alter brain structure in adolescents, impact cognition and emotions
item.description: The study led by physician-scientists at Oregon Health & Science University in the US warned that exposure to air pollution is associated with structural changes in the adolescent brain, specifically in the frontal and temporal regions -- the areas responsible for executive function, language, mood regulation, and socioemotional processing.

item.title: US visa re-entry delays prompt Google to advise employees not to travel internationally
item.description: The report from Business Insider said that Google's external counsel, BAL Immigration Law, cautioned employees needing visa stamping to return to the US, saying overseas travel could leave them stranded due to visa stamping appointment delays up to 12 months.

item.title: 'Strong pillar of India's safety': PM Modi extends greetings to SSB on Raising Day
item.description: "On the Raising Day of the Sashastra Seema Bal, I extend my greetings to all personnel associated with this force. SSB's unwavering dedication reflects the highest traditions of service. Their sense of duty remains a strong pillar of our nation's safety. From challenging terrains to demanding operational conditions, the SSB stands ever vigilant. Wishing them the very best in their endeavours ahead", PM Modi said in a post on X.
